limitations: The matcher fires on every MCP tool and the script selects Youdede servers case-insensitively, including plugin-scoped names (mcp__plugin_<plugin>_<server>__<tool>); MCP servers outside the Youdede namespace pass unchecked.

The documented PreToolUse payload carries no tool description or inventory, so on Claude Code the guard checks server and tool names; description drift is checked only when a payload includes that evidence.
